from typing import Any
import pytest
from tomlkit import parse
from tomlkit.toml_document import TOMLDocument


def test_missing_keys_in_repro_of_outofordertableproxy() -> None:
    a = parse(
        """
a.b.c = "d"
a.b.e = "f"
"""
    )
    value = a["a"]
    expected = {"b": {"c": "d", "e": "f"}}

    assert repr(value) == repr(expected)
